name: finalize_session_distill
description: Finalize a fully read session and consistent semantic review, using only this job's candidates. Optionally submit all memory_points here; runtime stages them via the existing candidate owner before the same source/evidence/lease/transaction gates. readback_verified=true proves saved changes passed fresh SQLite + ordinary-search checks; reuse returned knowledge_changes instead of another readback call. Unfinished work remains partial. For ordinary manual writes, use memory_points[i].review.evidence to bind each claim and retained condition to exact original text. The runtime checks the cited versions, may flag missing conditions in the conversation and paired Codex tool records, and checks retained phrases in the saved body. Existing staged callers can use final_scope_judgment; a proof string, missing judgment or omitted markers never authorizes a new write.

final_scope_judgment.description: Current Agent's final semantic judgment over actual output titles, bodies and authority. Supply a CandidateVerificationDecision with points, or a map from returned candidate_id to that decision. Never a proof string. Each output needs supported, durable scope_segments covering its exact final title + newline + statement (typed reports also bind rendered authority and native account identity); refine/replace also require update_meaning_judgment naming all exact predecessor statements/target_version values, successor statements and retained conditions/undecided state. Current-Agent manual work requires no background CLI permission or task_model_budget. Runtime source reopening and CAS still apply.

items.description: One verbatim claim segment and its independently judged future use.

anyOf.description:
Whether one whole refine or replace keeps still-applicable meaning.

The selected host executor or the current Agent supplies this judgment.
Runtime code checks that ``successor_statements`` are exactly the output
statements of the whole point, in order, that ``predecessor_statements``
and ``predecessor_versions`` name the exact replaced rows, and that every
named condition and undecided state occurs in those successor statements.
A hash only freezes those bytes. It does not judge preservation, and
neither does keyword overlap or support for each new sentence by itself.
Omitting the judgment is not a claim that no condition applied.

condition_exclusions.description: Only for returned source_conditions_need_review findings. Key by condition check id; explain why the clause is out of scope, obsolete, unsupported, or session-only.

memory_points.description: All decisions for this prepared job; do not call suggest separately for these points. Runtime derives project, job, category and source explanation.

verification_outcome.description: Writing dispositions require verified: the fully read typed source supports this exact point. user_statement verifies what the user stated; source_report verifies that speaker's bounded account, not external truth. not_applicable is for intentional non-writing points.

items.description: Integrity reference used by Dream admission, never evidence content.

locator.description: Transient project-relative path, or absolute path under a user-configured evidence.repository_roots entry. Source/session refs use the owning distill job instead of storing a raw locator.
locator.title: Locator

items.title: EvidenceRef

review.description: Current Agent's content judgment. Conditions and undecided_state are literal retained phrases. Use evidence to cite exact quotes by one-based verification_refs position. Bind claim, each condition and undecided state. Conversation quotes require the message_index within the cited role; file quotes omit it. Condition bindings also name the exact retained phrase. For observed operations, operations binds the checked native call/result pair and its observation level. For refine/replace, preserves_meaning=true affirms all still-applicable meaning; report updates also require same_topic=true.

items.description: Exact quote in a point's typed reference, supplied to manual finalization.
Claim and exact, paired native call/result passages for an observed operation.

retained_state_item.description: Only if this explicitly classified user current-state point was also mistakenly listed in unfinished_work: must exactly equal both point content and that work item. Excluded only after verified successful promotion; real handoffs stay.

semantic_review.description: Final outcome, contradictions, unfinished work, and evidence assessment

session_summary.description: Concise human-readable account of what the session was about, independent of memory promotion

unfinished_work.description: Actual unfinished actions only. Supported undecided/unknown states belong in memory_points, not this work list.

retained_state_refs.description: Optional compatibility binding for an explicitly classified current state also listed as work; batch memory_points derives these internally.

zero_candidate_challenge.description: Optional detailed review for compatibility; an explicit no_promotion review needs no extra questionnaire. Use the content hashes returned by semantic exchange drilldown.
